observations: Justin supplies the strongest complete explanation: source-protection motive, favor transport and donor-glass opportunity, and an admitted fragment disposal physically traced to the stolen cyanide bottle. Innocent accounts vary in evidential strength; late admissions, independent lab findings and cancellation logs are stronger than capped-favor claims. No accomplice theory is necessary.
